title: The conditional superiority of fast silicon sampling
abstract: arXiv:2608.14079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Silicon sampling can produce surprisingly good population estimates at times. Does doing it fast attenuate such fidelity? In this study, we extend and assess ongoing work in silicon sampling by comparing the algorithmic fidelity of "fast" and "slow" modes of silicon sampling among a nationally representative sample of Singaporean survey respondents. We find that silicon sampling with contemporary frontier models remains a method in early development to be used only with great caution. While silicon samples are able to produce moderately faithful estimates of population means, they continue to understate opinion variance and distort the latent contextual space behind human opinions. Conditional on such limitations, we find "fast" modes of silicon sampling to be relatively superior to traditional "slow" modes of silicon sampling. Fast silicon sampling is significantly more efficient in compute resources and run-time while being monotonical

translated_title: 快速硅采样的条件优越性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14079v1 公告类型：新 摘要：硅采样有时能产生出奇好的人口估计。快速进行这种采样是否会削弱其保真度？在本研究中，我们扩展并评估了硅采样的现有工作，通过比较新加坡全国代表性调查受访者中“快速”和“慢速”硅采样模式的算法保真度。我们发现，使用当代前沿模型的硅采样仍是一种早期开发的方法，只能极其谨慎地使用。虽然硅样本能够对人口均值产生中等保真的估计，但它们仍会低估意见方差，并扭曲人类意见背后的潜在情境空间。在这种限制条件下，我们发现“快速”模式的硅采样相对于传统“慢速”模式的硅采样具有相对优越性。快速硅采样在计算资源和运行时间上显著更高效，同时保持单调性。
tldr: 本文发现快速硅采样在计算效率和运行时间上优于慢速模式，尽管整体硅采样仍存局限性，但快速模式在条件限制下展现出相对优越性。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that fast silicon sampling is superior to slow modes in computational efficiency and runtime, showing relative advantage despite overall limitations of silicon sampling.
